item.title: Custom Printed Folding Carton Box for Electronics Accessories
item.description:
Product Overview

Custom printed folding carton boxes designed specifically for electronics accessories — USB cables, chargers, earbuds, phone cases, adapters, and small consumer electronics. Manufactured by Guangdong Bincai Color Printing Co., Ltd. in our 10,000 sqm Foshan factory with over 22 years of packaging expertise. Our folding cartons combine precision die-cutting, vibrant CMYK offset printing, and durable board stock to protect and present your products.

Manufacturing Specifications

  • Press: Heidelberg 7+1 UV and KBA 1050 4-color offset presses
  • Die-cutting: Bobst flatbed die-cutters with ±0.5mm precision
  • Daily output: Up to 1.7 million color boxes per day
  • Board stock: SBS C1S (15-24pt), CCNB, coated art paper (250-450gsm)
  • Inks: Soy-based, low-VOC, food-safe upon request
  • Certifications: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management, FSC Chain-of-Custody

Customization Options

  • Sizing: Any dimensions from 50mm × 50mm × 10mm to 500mm × 400mm × 200mm
  • Printing: Full CMYK offset + Pantone spot colors, up to 7+1 UV
  • Finishes: Matte/gloss lamination, soft-touch coating, spot UV, aqueous varnish
  • Embellishments: Gold/silver/copper foil hot stamping, blind embossing/debossing
  • Structure: Tuck-top, auto-lock bottom, reverse tuck, straight tuck, sleeve + tray
  • Window patching: PVC/PET die-cut window for product visibility
  • Inserts: Custom die-cut corrugated or foam inserts for product protection

Applications

Ideal for electronics accessories brands, contract manufacturers, and distributors packaging: USB cables, wireless earbuds, phone cases, screen protectors, power banks, chargers, adapters, dongles, smartwatch bands, portable speakers, and small IoT devices.

item.title: Recyclable Kraft Folding Carton Eco-Friendly Food Packaging
item.description:
Overview

Guangdong Bincai Color Printing’s recyclable kraft folding carton for eco-friendly food packaging delivers sustainable protection with brand-forward printing. FSC certified kraft paperboard, soy-based inks, and water-based adhesives ensure full recyclability and industrial compostability. Manufactured in our ISO 9001:2015 certified 10,000 sqm facility with KBA 1050 4-color and Heidelberg 7+1 UV presses — 22 years of experience, daily output 1.7 million boxes.

Applications

  • Organic & Natural Foods: Granola, snack bars, dried fruit, nuts, tea, superfoods
  • Bakery & Confectionery: Artisan bread, cookies, chocolates, pastries with food-safe inks
  • Takeaway & Delivery: Eco-conscious restaurant to-go packaging with brand printing
  • Farmers Markets: Honey jars, jam, preserves, handmade goods — rustic kraft aesthetic
  • Coffee & Tea: Specialty coffee bags, loose-leaf tea cartons, gift sets
  • Meal Kit & Subscription: Dry ingredient compartments, recipe card inserts
  • Health & Wellness: Supplement cartons, protein bars, wellness product packaging

Customization Options

  • Styles: Tuck-top (straight/reverse), auto-lock bottom, gable top, sleeve, window carton
  • Sizes: Fully custom — 60×40×20mm to 400×300×120mm
  • Materials: FSC kraft paperboard (200–350gsm), recycled kraft, solid bleached sulfate
  • Printing: Soy-based CMYK offset, Pantone spot colors, food-safe indirect contact certified
  • Finishes: Aqueous matte/gloss coating, blind embossing, registered emboss, no-plastic policy
  • Windows: PLA biodegradable film window, die-cut open window, or no-window
  • Inserts: Die-cut kraft dividers, molded pulp trays, corrugated partitions
  • Closure: Tuck flap, auto-lock bottom, tear strip, paper sticker seal

Production Specifications

Parameter Specification
Press Heidelberg Speedmaster 7+1 UV / KBA 1050 4-color offset
Substrate FSC certified kraft paperboard, 200–350gsm
Ink System Soy-based vegetable inks, EN 71-3 / FDA indirect food contact compliant
Adhesive Water-based PVA, solvent-free, pH neutral, repulpable
Coating Aqueous (water-based) — maintains recyclability
Daily Capacity 1.7 million color boxes + 220,000+ gift boxes
Factory Size 10,000 sqm main + 8,000 sqm smart factory (2025)

Quality Assurance

  • ISO 9001:2015 certified — documented QC at every production stage
  • FSC chain-of-custody: 100% traceable from forest to finished carton
  • Print quality: spectrophotometer density check every 500 sheets, registration ±0.15mm
  • Die-cut precision: ±0.3mm tolerance, 100% folding and gluing verification
  • Food safety: soy inks certified for indirect food contact, no migratory substances
  • Final inspection: AQL 2.5 Level II, third-party testing via SGS/Intertek available
  • Free pre-production samples with 5–7 day turnaround

Sustainability

  • FSC Mix Credit: Full chain-of-custody, on-pack FSC logo available
  • Soy Inks: USDA BioPreferred, biodegradable, low-VOC, heavy-metal-free
  • Plastic-Free: No lamination film, no synthetic coatings, no plastic windows (PLA option available)
  • Water-Based Adhesives: Repulpable in standard recycling, zero VOC emissions
  • Compostable: EN 13432 industrial compostability certification available
  • Carbon: ~40% lower footprint vs plastic-laminated equivalent

Why Bincai

22 years of manufacturing excellence (founded 2003), operating a 10,000 sqm fully integrated factory in Foshan — Pearl River Delta packaging hub. KBA 1050 4-color and Heidelberg 7+1 UV presses, 150+ skilled staff, serving brands in 40+ countries with 98%+ on-time delivery.

item.title: Straight Tuck End Folding Carton Box with Matte Lamination
item.description:
Product Overview

The straight tuck end (STE) folding carton is one of the most versatile and cost-effective packaging formats in commercial printing. Manufactured at Guangdong Bincai Color Printing’s 18,000 sqm integrated facility (10,000 sqm + 8,000 sqm smart factory expansion in 2025), this box features a clean matte lamination finish that delivers a premium tactile feel while protecting the printed surface from scuffing and moisture. With 22 years of box-making heritage (founded 2003), Bincai produces over 1.7 million color boxes daily across KBA 1050 4-color and Heidelberg 7+1 UV presses — making it one of the Pearl River Delta’s most capable folding carton manufacturers. ISO 9001:2015 quality management and FSC Chain-of-Custody certification ensure consistent production quality and responsible material sourcing for every order.
